title: fair-med: bias detection and fairness evaluation in healthcare-focused XAI
core_idea: Introduce fair-med, a model-agnostic framework for bias detection and fairness evaluation in healthcare AI that emphasizes intersectional fairness by quantifying compounded effects of multiple demographic attributes using a compound fairness score and entropy-based weighting to aggregate bias metrics in a data-driven, interpretable way.
tldr: Proposes fair-med, a model-agnostic approach to detect and evaluate intersectional biases in healthcare AI by combining a compound fairness score with entropy-based weighting to prioritize and interpret the most impactful sources of bias.
